game.q: no one is there to back him up. he touches the earth. then?
opts: the earth itself speaks up for him

wrong.charge: they tried. then they ran out of army.
wrong.ref: no ref. the ground made the call.

game.right: YES. as the old texts tell it, the earth roared: i am his witness. and mara’s army scattered.

end.line: with no one to speak for him, the buddha touched the earth, and the earth spoke up.
end.l1: no one spoke up for him.
